description:
**Blocked by d06.3, d06.4, d06.5 (transcript wiring + leaves +
composites must be VDom-compatible). d06.7, d06.9, d06.10, d06.11,
d06.13, d06.14 may still be in flight — Compat adapter from d06.1
covers anything not yet converted. Read deck §12 "Extension points"
and §13 "Worked example" before starting.**

Replace `Interactive.build_screen/2` with
`Components.Screen.render/3`, a single root component that returns
a VFlow of [Header, Resources, Transcript, Loader, PendingMessages,
Input, InputDropdown, Notification, Footer]. Custom widgets and
dialogs are mounted as conditional VHoles.

**Read first:**
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex` lines
  1939-1999 — current `build_screen/2` body. Notice the manual
  list-concat (`++`), the `[""]` prefix that opens the screen,
  the bespoke `custom_widget` escape hatch, and the
  `render_dialog_overlay/3` switch.
- Same file lines 1023-1073 — `send_render/1`, the dispatcher to
  RenderLoop, plus all the `render_*` helpers (`header_lines/4`,
  `footer_lines/3`, `render_resource_sections/3`,
  `render_loader/3`, `render_pending_messages/4`,
  `render_notification/2`).
- Same file lines 2316-2399 — `banner_lines/4`, `render_loader/3`,
  resource section helpers. Several of these will be inlined into
  the Screen component or removed.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/overlay.ex` — the overlay
  positioning system. Stays put; Screen renders an Overlay VHole
  when one is pushed.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/render_context.ex` — RenderContext
  shape (theme, width, padding_x, hide_thinking, etc.). Threaded
  through Screen as is.

**New module:**
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/screen.ex` — the
  root component. Single `render(props, ctx, h)` that returns the
  VFlow tree.

**Slot resolution (deck §12 prep — actual extension API in d06.16):**
Lay the `OctoPi.TUI.UI.Slots` module groundwork now even though
extensions can't use it yet:

  ```elixir
  defmodule OctoPi.TUI.UI.Slots do
    @builtin %{
      header: Components.Header,
      footer: Components.Footer,
      banner: Components.WelcomeBanner,
      loader: Components.Loader,
      notification: Components.Notification
    }

    def resolve(state, slot_id) do
      Map.get(state.ui.slot_overrides, slot_id, Map.fetch!(@builtin, slot_id))
    end

    def override(state, slot_id, component_or_nil), do: ...
  end
  ```

Screen calls `UI.Slots.resolve/2` for each region; built-in resolution
returns the existing module. d06.16 wires `Coder.Extensions.UI` casts
into `UI.Slots.override/3`.

**Custom widget migration:**
The `{from, %{render: fn w -> lines end}}` escape in
`Interactive.handle_call({:ui_request, {:custom, factory, _kw}}, …)`
becomes a regular VHole. The factory's output is wrapped via the
Compat adapter (d06.1). State carries `state.ui.custom_widget` as
`{from_pid, vhole_or_nil}`; Screen mounts it when present.

**Dialog migration:**
The `render_dialog_overlay/3` switch is deleted. d06.13 and d06.14
convert the dialogs themselves; this ticket integrates them into
Screen as conditional VHoles based on which dialog flag is set in
state. If d06.13/14 haven't landed when this lands, use Compat
adapters; the audit (d06.15) catches any straggling Compat use.

**The leading blank line:** Today `build_screen/2` returns
`[""] ++ all`. Screen must emit an equivalent leading gap — one
`%VFlow{}` whose first child is a single empty `%VText{text: ""}`,
or via a `padding_y: 1` on the outermost VFlow. Pick whichever
keeps the byte-diff zero.

**Acceptance:**
- `Interactive.build_screen/2` deleted from interactive.ex; replaced
  by a one-line call to `Components.Screen.render/3` from
  `send_render/1`.
- Pixel-diff test: byte-for-byte equality between legacy
  `build_screen` output and the new Screen output for a
  representative state fixture (idle prompt, streaming response
  with tool calls, dialog open, custom widget mounted).
- All `render_*` helpers in interactive.ex that were specific to
  `build_screen` are deleted (or moved into `Components.Screen`
  as private helpers).
- The `custom_widget` field semantics preserved: callers that
  invoke `Interactive.ui_request({:custom, factory, opts})` still
  see their factory output appear and still get a `{:done, result}`
  response when complete.
- `render_dialog_overlay/3` and its branches deleted from
  interactive.ex.
- `mix test` 1251+ green; tmux smoke run with prompts +
  dialogs + a registered custom widget.

comments.text: Superseded by the tui2 architecture decision in docs/tui-architecture.md. The d06 plan refactored octo_pi_tui in place; the new direction builds octo_pi_tui2 as a parallel implementation on Filament, leaving octo_pi_tui frozen. New epics: opi-58c, opi-pyl, opi-yhj, opi-t3t, opi-ow9, opi-4tr, opi-m6b. Closing without further work.

title: Replace Interactive.build_screen/2 with a single root component
